message: The other day, I decided it was high time to check our go-bags. I opened mine and found a half-eaten granola bar from last summer—and a very confused sock. 😅 It hit me how easy it is to forget what we have tucked away for emergencies. It’s a bit comical, really, but it reminded me that staying prepared doesn’t have to be a chore; it can just be a little check-in every now and then. What’s the most surprising thing you’ve found in your go-bag?
